item.tib: 'chi med yab sras mjal theb rang rig don gyi gdams pa
item.coloph: bla chen dran pa yab sras kyi mjal theb/ gdams pa gser gyi yang zhun 'di/ bla chen bdag gis thugs bcud bsdus/ skal ldan khyod la snyan du brgyud/ gsang ba thabs la mkhas par gyis/ kha lta can la ma shor cig ri khrod 'grims pa'i cha rkyen mdzod/ u ya/ ag tham/ sa ma ya//
